details: Bitcoin traded resiliently around $77,900 on August 31, 2026, despite renewed conflict between the US and Iran driving oil prices above $90 per barrel and pressuring global stocks. The cryptocurrency gained approximately 23% in August, outperforming both gold and Nasdaq. The Federal Reserve's hawkish stance suggests a potential September rate hike, with the upcoming US jobs report on September 4 being a key market event.
title: Bitcoin holds steady near $78K despite US-Iran tensions lifting oil prices.

details: Bitcoin experienced a drop to around $77,800 on August 28, 2026, following US Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish speech at the Jackson Hole Economic Symposium. Warsh emphasized persistent inflation and the Fed's commitment to price stability, which shifted market expectations towards a higher probability of a 25-basis-point rate hike in September. Higher rate expectations typically pressure risk-sensitive assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Bitcoin Drops After Hawkish Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole Speech.
